accepted_structure: explicit per-probe checked ops opt-in and unchanged default empty hooks
partial hooks/mixed/multi-DAI rejected before shared IO
CPU begin before codec, component completion before codec/CPU commits
idle shared tuple reuse skips machine CCF and codec PLL/shared writes
checked cache owner release distinct from open clock leases

required_changes.finding: Repeated commit with same cookie after successful commit currently calls abort and revokes committed owner/cache.
required_changes.required: Only a currently pending matching commit may self-clean; repeated/stale commit must reject without mutation.

required_changes.finding: Failed reuse CPU commit clears reservation before core can undo already committed codec, allowing START between endpoints.
required_changes.required: Keep CPU pending/configuring through codec abort until final CPU abort or establish sticky START ban before opening; test actual callback window.

required_changes.finding: soc_component_ret macro/private inline exists only in soc-component.c, not the new caller soc-pcm.c translation unit.
required_changes.required: Use a legal local reporting path preserving first errno; single-unit model must not mask cross-TU visibility.

required_changes.finding: Real asoc_simple_init_dai sends positive sysclk before owner/pending and default clk_direction is IN. Current setters reject this runtime-initialization path.
required_changes.required: Validate exact fixed positive frequency with legal enum without IO/cache publication; keep strict zero teardown gate and test actual initializer.

required_changes.finding: Machine free in params abort currently follows CPU abort; cleanup failure/shared work can occur after CPU START reservation opens.
required_changes.required: CPU abort is last after all cleanup and codec undo, or prior sticky START ban; preserve first errno and actual link callback behavior.
